name: sheetco
title: SheetCo
product: SheetCo builds a small spreadsheet engine. The team designs its own module split and interfaces in the kickoff meeting; requirements arrive in waves.
context: The product: Sheet, a spreadsheet engine, specified by behaviour only in live/bench5/SPEC5.md (read all of it; it grows by waves, and every new wave is announced on the company channel and in your brief). There is no module spec: the kickoff meeting MTG-1 decides the split into four module slots (A-D) plus the integration module (SHEET), every interface between them, and which slot owns which behaviour; ARCH.md (order ARCH, in live/bench5/work/ARCH/) records those decisions and is the contract. Each slot's module lives in live/bench5/work/MOD-<slot>/<file named in ARCH.md>; modules import each other by relative paths ARCH.md gives. Shipped modules are in live/bench5/shipped/. Hidden acceptance tests run only on the integrated sheet and report failing categories; every shipped order is tested again after each later ship. When a wave's failure is in another slot's module, say so in your report: the slot's owner fixes it. The org is in ORG.md.
